text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, not at all!! I'm full of energy, 
see?! In fact, I'm just about to practice 
my swings—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha...! Come to think of it, I hung 
them to dry in my room! I'll go grab them 
real quick~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps Bamboo Memory is still 
fatigued from the race. It seems necessary 
to reconsider the upcoming race schedule."
